scope: Independent Spec/protocol source reading before owner evidence review
source_read: unchanged runtime timeouts and Playwright config
limitations: No original case or product tests rerun
Metadata timing cannot prove original CI failure cause
ack_received means the hook has resolved an ACK (may already be durable); it alone is not proof of a new HTTP delivery
Async diagnostic persistence adds a bounded post-assertion wait, not a new business retry or longer click timeout
